description: This file defines the MiddlewareDispatcher class for the Slim Framework, managing middleware stacks and request handling within the web application.

classes.name: MiddlewareDispatcher
classes.description: A class that manages a stack of middleware components for HTTP request processing within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware dispatcher with a kernel, optional callable resolver, and container.

methods.name: seedMiddlewareStack
methods.description: Initializes the middleware stack with a starting request handler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Invokes the current middleware stack to process an incoming server request.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a middleware component to the stack, handling objects, strings, or callables.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a middleware object implementing MiddlewareInterface to the stack.

methods.name: addDeferred
methods.description: Adds middleware specified by class name, resolving it later during request handling.

methods.name: addCallable
methods.description: Adds a custom callable middleware to the stack.
